examples.en: He felt a sudden inexpressible loneliness.
examples.zh: 他突然有种难以言喻的孤独感。

examples.en: Many deaf people have feelings of isolation and loneliness.
examples.zh: 许多失聪的人有孤独和寂寞的感觉。

examples.en: I have so many friends, but deep down, underneath, I have a fear of loneliness.
examples.zh: 我有这么多朋友，但是内心深处我还是有一种对孤独的恐惧。
